ukmt-imc-2026-01.prompt: Which of these has the largest value?

ukmt-imc-2026-02.prompt: What time will it be 2026 minutes after 20:26 on Monday?

ukmt-imc-2026-07.prompt: The five numbers 95, 96, 97, 98, 99 are each paired with one of the five numbers 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 (each number used once). ukmt-imc-2026-16.prompt: Kerry and Karen are driving to meet each other. They both leave home at mid-day and both drive at the same constant speed. At 1 pm they are 200 km apart by road. At 2:15 pm they are 100 km apart. How far apart by road do Karen and Kerry live?

ukmt-imc-2026-21.prompt: The numbers $x$ and $y$ satisfy the equations $x+y=6$ and $x^3+y^3=198$. What is the value of $xy$?

ukmt-imc-2026-22.prompt: A bumblebee wants to visit all the hexagons in the diagram shown. He starts at X, only moves between hexagons that share a border, and never visits the same hexagon twice. How many possible routes could the bumblebee take?

What is the smallest number of people who could have answered no to Teresa?

ukmt-imc-2026-24.prompt: The points $K$, $L$, $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of the edges of the quadrilateral $PQRS$, as shown. $T$ is a point inside the quadrilateral. The quadrilaterals $KQLT$, $LRMT$ and $MSNT$ have areas 20, 24 and 15 respectively. What is the area of the quadrilateral $NPKT$?

ukmt-imc-2026-25.prompt: Zoe has an unusual method of choosing when to go swimming.
